$comment: Pirelli 2011-2013: tyres built to wear out. Every compound wears faster than the base game's, loses grip sooner and drops off a steeper cliff, so a team that is kind to its tyres can beat a faster car. The temperature windows are narrower and lower, so hot races punish cars that run their tyres hot. The game still has three dry compounds; 2012 nominated two of four per race (super soft, soft, medium, hard), which the soft and hard stand in for.
